components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Used for main form submissions, starting live scans, and adding students.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.25); transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Status Badge (On-Time / Verified)
components.description: Pill indicator for on-time student check-ins and connected IoT devices.
components.css: .ds-badge-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; background: #d1fae5; color: #059669; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-badge-success .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: #10b981; border-radius: 50%; }

narrative.overview: The IoT Face Attendance dashboard visual system is engineered for high-trust institutional and educational operations. It balances a high-tech biometric surveillance aesthetic with the clean, approachable precision of modern SaaS analytics.
keyCharacteristics: High-Contrast Telemetry with clear separation between camera monitors and data tables
Biometric Color Semantics (Emerald for match/on-time, Amber for late, Rose for stranger)
Tabular Precision with monospace numbers for timestamps and confidence rates
Card-First Spatial Model with rounded-2xl geometry

rules.name: The Strict Semantic Triad Rule
rules.body: Never use green for decorative accents; green strictly signals verified recognition or online hardware.

rules.name: The Tabular Data Rule
rules.body: All timestamps, countdown timers, and student IDs must carry .tabular-nums to eliminate column jitter.

rules.name: The Ghost Border Fallback Rule
rules.body: Every elevated white card must include a 1px border stroke (border-slate-200/80) to guarantee contrast.

dos: Do format all time strings with leading zeros and use .tabular-nums.
Do render all dialogs and popovers via createPortal(..., document.body) with z-[9999].
Do preserve the 60-second anti-spam check-in cooldown on real-time face matching loops.
donts: Don't use pure black (#000000) for text; always use Midnight Slate (#0f172a).
Don't place fixed-position modals inside elements with CSS transform properties.
Don't disable scan/recognition action buttons when the database has 0 registered faces.
